paragraphs.text: NATO responded to the 20 Nov RUS missile incursion into POL with an extraordinary NAC on 23 Nov: allies said Russia “bears full responsibility” and SACEUR forward-deployed one AWACS; POL chose not to invoke Article 4. A RUS jet-powered drone flew ~20 km into POL airspace for nine minutes the same evening, which the MoD judges deliberate. Warsaw summoned the RUS representative, who said no “verifiable evidence” had been presented; Kosiniak-Kamysz convened the national security committee on 24 Nov on allied support, AWACS and a permanent US base.
Rutte meets Trump at Mar-a-Lago on 25 Nov, following the NAC on POL and Kyiv’s push for four-party talks. No media opportunity is planned.

The Bundestag votes the 2027 defence budget on 25 Nov: €139.4 billion, including €29.6 billion from the Bundeswehr special fund, with procurement above €60 billion—the highest level since the Cold War. On 23 Nov Pistorius hosted UKR Defence Minister Khmara, funding ~€34 million of production capacity for the Babka reconnaissance drone and signing an MoI on the Delta battle-management system; he said UKR has the right to strike military targets in RUS.

At the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin, Rutte urged national parliaments to vote the budgets needed for the new spending commitments; the Assembly called for a shift from short-term aid to a defence-industrial partnership with UKR. Wadephul said “Protecting Vilnius is protecting Berlin”, while Merz called reports of a RUS nuclear-capable satellite shocking; Peskov said they were “hardly worth taking seriously”.

Zelensky confirmed the 21 Nov UKR strike on the cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland, which he said carried weapons and drifted into FIN waters after being hit in RUS waters. Acknowledging that “some European partners are worried” about Baltic incidents, he ordered officials to brief partners in advance. LTU rejected RUS claims that a drone targeting Kaliningrad came from its territory.

MI5’s National Protective Security Authority warned UK firms supplying UKR’s armed forces that they are targeted by the RUS state through cyber attacks, sabotage and disinformation. Ministers met defence and critical-infrastructure executives on 24–25 Nov; Security Minister Jarvis cited “recent sabotage attempts right across Europe”.

Zelensky called on 23 Nov for four-party talks (UKR, Europe, US, RUS) as soon as possible, and told Bloomberg that Witkoff and Kushner want “to move very quickly”, adding that peace must not come “at Ukraine’s expense alone”. Peskov said Moscow does not yet understand what “added value” Europeans would bring; no date is set for the next trilateral round in Abu Dhabi.

ROU issued an RO-Alert in northern Tulcea on 24 Nov after radar detected a presumed RUS drone in UKR airspace near the border; two ESP F-18s on NATO air policing scrambled from Mihail Kogălniceanu. MApN reported no violation of ROU airspace.
